last_review.summary: AUTH-010-C meets the task requirements and architecture constraints. The injectable stateless lifecycle service composes the existing generator and repository, returns raw key material only after successful persistence, exposes only safe metadata for create/list, delegates active-only revocation, stays within allowed paths, and passes TypeScript build and Prisma validation.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
